jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin (February 2027)
jobs.description:
Company Description

At KEENFINITY Group
, we are a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions. With over 4,000 employees in over 50 countries worldwide, our ambition is clear: we offer more than just technology – we secure, connect, and amplify the moments that matter in life.

Our Audio business is part of the Keenfinity Group and operates as an independent company – giving our iconic brands the independence and agility to thrive in today’s market. As part of a global family that includes Bosch, RTS, Electro-Voice, Dynacord, and Telex
, we deliver world-class professional audio, building safety, intercom, and communication solutions that connect concerts, broadcasts, houses of worship, stadiums, and schools. We develop and manufacture these systems in our own plants across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Our vision is to be the industry’s most admired company, driven by customer success. We strive to live and work according to our core values of Customer Success, Passion, Boldness, and Integrity.

Customer Success: Unmatched customer experience, end to end.

Passion: We love what we do, it drives everything we deliver.

Boldness: We challenge the status quo. We innovate. We lead.

Integrity: We do the right thing. Always.

What’s in it for you?

Working with us means experiencing the best of both worlds: the global impact and prestige of industry-leading brands, combined with the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a newly independent company. In this dynamic environment, your ideas will not get lost in bureaucracy. We empower you to take true ownership, accelerate your growth, and collaborate with passionate experts worldwide to build solutions you can genuinely be proud of.

Job Description

As a Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin
, you will help us rebuild and significantly expand the software simulator for our DICENTIS conference devices
. The simulator acts like real hardware on the network, allowing our development and test teams to validate server behavior, run automated regression tests, and develop software without always needing access to physical devices.

We already have an existing simulator, but it currently covers only a limited set of device behaviors and runs on an aging technology stack. Your project will be to rebuild it using a newer technology foundation that we are already investing in, while expanding its coverage from approximately 30% to 80–90% of real device behavior
.

You will work on a long-term project with a tangible impact on how our engineering teams develop, test, and maintain our products. The final solution will run on both Windows and Linux
and become an important part of our automated testing and development environment.

During Your Internship, You Will

Get familiar with the existing device simulator, DICENTIS devices, and the newer technology stack used for the rebuild.
Analyze the behavior and capabilities of real devices and identify which scenarios are already simulated and which are still missing.
Define and prioritize the device behaviors required to significantly expand simulator coverage.
Design and implement new simulated device scenarios using C# and/or C++.
Develop software that communicates over the network and behaves like the corresponding physical devices.
Make the simulator compatible with both Windows and Linux.
Develop and maintain automated tests that use the simulator as a replacement for physical hardware.
Integrate the simulator into our automated build and test pipeline, including continuous integration where applicable.
Document supported device behaviors, architecture, usage, and known limitations.
Work closely with engineers and testers to understand their needs and ensure the simulator is practical for everyday development and testing.
Break down a long-term project into manageable milestones and provide regular progress updates to your supervising team.

Qualifications

You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field.
Solid programming skills in C# and/or C++.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, client-server communication, and networked devices.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and break down a larger project into manageable steps.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
Motivation to learn, investigate technical problems, and develop a solution from an existing foundation.

It Is a Plus If You Have

Experience with .NET or .NET Core.
Familiarity with network protocols or device communication standards.
Experience with automated testing or continuous integration tools such as Jenkins.
Experience working in a Linux-based development environment.
Coursework or project experience in software engineering, networking, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
An interest in audio, conferencing technology, embedded systems, or connected devices.

Additional Information

💼 What We Offer:

A hands-on internship in an international team.
Close guidance from experienced professionals.
A dynamic role where your input and ideas are appreciated.
The option to work from home one day per week.
An internship allowance between €500 and €600 per month (based on full-time employment).

📝 Application Process

Interested? Hit the apply button!
Phone meeting with a Keenfinity Group campus recruiter;
Interview with team members;
Contract offers from Keenfinity Group.

🌱 Join us at KEENFINITY!

At Keenfinity Group we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology.

We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self.

Keenfinity is an equal opportunity employer, offering equal opportunities for all. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and can offer support, if needed. When everyone has a chance to contribute, we all do better.

jobs.title: Senior Dynamics F&O Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

This is Allego

Allego is the leading company for fast and ultra-fast charging solutions to companies and consumers throughout Europe. We build and operate our public charging network ranging from regular charging to state-of-the-art high-power charging that can be used by all electric cars, providing a seamless charging experience. Our goal is to contribute to zero-emission mobility and allow EV drivers to charge at the right place with the right speed.

The EV market is emerging and changing rapidly. With our proven track record and long experience, we keep driving forward with confidence.

About The Role

As a Senior Dynamics 365 Engineer, you will play a key role in strengthening our Dynamics landscape across F&O, CE, and the Power Platform. You’ll work within a skilled internal engineering team supporting the technology behind Allego’s European charging infrastructure operations.

In this role, you will design, build, and improve solutions across our full Dynamics stack - from X++ development in F&O to Power Apps and integrations using Azure services. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, and internal business stakeholders to build reliable, scalable, and future-ready systems.

We are looking for someone who enjoys working across multiple Dynamics areas, is comfortable in a modern engineering environment, and is eager to help us further adopt the Power Platform and Azure technologies.

What You Will Do

Develop, extend, and optimise functionality in Dynamics 365 F&O and Dynamics 365 CE
Build solutions using Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Design and implement integrations using Azure Logic Apps, REST APIs, OData, DMF, and Azure API Management
Participate in solution design, code reviews, and technical architecture discussions
Work with Azure DevOps to manage work items, repositories, branching, and CI/CD pipelines
Ensure best practices in the D365 extension model, code quality, performance, and maintainability
Support continuous improvement of our development approach (e.g., automated testing, RSAT/ATL, LCS environment management)
Work closely with functional consultants and internal customers to analyse requirements and translate them into clean, scalable solutions
Break down work into deliverables and provide accurate time estimates

Job Requirements

What You Bring

5+ years professional development experience with Dynamics 365 F&O / X++.
Strong experience with Power Platform (PowerApps, Power Automate, Dataverse).
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD.
Solid understanding of integrations, including REST APIs, OData, DMF, and Logic Apps.
Nice to have experience with Dynamics 365 CE / CRM development.
Comfortable working in an Agile environment and collaborating in hybrid teams.
Ability to communicate clearly with internal customers and colleagues.
You are fluent in English.
You are able to visit our office in Arnhem.

Our Offer

This role allows you to work within a team of specialists contributing directly to the technology powering European EV charging. You will be at the forefront of modern charging and mobility solutions.

We offer a competitive salary package with strong secondary conditions, including:

End-of-year premium
Personal budget
A solid pension scheme
Opportunities for professional training and certifications
Hybrid working: a healthy balance between our Arnhem office and working from home

You’ll join colleagues who are motivated to make a real impact and who believe that working together is the key to driving zero-emission mobility forward. Expect a challenging role in a fast-paced, ambitious environment where you can grow, innovate, and help shape our Dynamics landscape.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer (m/w/d) – C# / .NET
jobs.description:
Du liebst sauberen Code, moderne Softwarearchitekturen und technische Herausforderungen?

Du möchtest nicht nur bestehende Systeme betreuen, sondern aktiv an der Neuentwicklung innovativer Softwarelösungen
mitwirken?

Dann werde Teil der Vivecti Group
und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die technologische Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens- unterstützt durch moderne Cloud-Technologien und KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge.

Deine Aufgaben

Du konzipierst und entwickelst moderne, leistungsfähige und skalierbare Backend-Systeme auf Basis von C# und .NET 8+.
Du arbeitest maßgeblich an der Neuentwicklung von Softwareprodukten und Plattformen und bringst eigene Ideen in Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen ein.
Du entwirfst und implementierst robuste RESTful APIs und dokumentierst diese im OpenAPI-Standard.
Du entwickelst moderne modulare Servicearchitektur und Cloud-native Architekturen für zukunftsfähige Anwendungen.

Du entwickelst und optimierst Unit-, Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests.
Du arbeitest mit CI/CD-Pipelines, Container-Technologien und modernen Cloud-Plattformen.
Du entwickelst Lösungen im Umfeld von Event-Driven Architectures und Message-Brokern wie RabbitMQ oder Azure Service Bus.
Du arbeitest eng mit Entwickler:innen, Product Ownern und Stakeholdern zusammen.

Das wünschen wir uns von Dir

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Anwendungen mit C# und .NET.

Erfahrung in der Neuentwicklung von Softwarelösungen, idealerweise in komplexen Systemlandschaften.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von RESTful APIs und OpenAPI/Swagger.
Fundierte Erfahrung mit Clean Code, SOLID-Prinzipien, objektorientierter Softwareentwicklung und Design Patterns.
Erfahrung mit Testframeworks wie xUnit, NUnit oder MSTest.
Erfahrung mit CI/CD, Docker und idealerweise Kubernetes.
Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL oder MySQL.
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien, idealerweise Microsoft Azure.
Erfahrung mit Event-Driven Architectures und Message-Brokern.
Erfahrung mit modernen KI-Tools für Softwareentwicklung oder großes Interesse an deren Einsatz.
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Hoher Qualitätsanspruch und Begeisterung für moderne Softwareentwicklung.

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

Sicherheit: Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem wachsenden Unternehmen der Gesundheitsbranche mit attraktiver Vergütung

Als erfahrenes Versicherungs- und Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen verbinden wir seit 1819 Wachstum mit Tradition. Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld voller Offenheit, Teamgeist und Rückhalt. Gemeinsam mit dir formen wir aus unseren individuellen Kompetenzen ein starkes Team: die ALH Gruppe. Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten im .NET-Umfeld unter Einsatz von C# sowie gängigen Webtechnologien (z. B. JavaScript, HTML, CSS)

Sicherer Umgang mit Software-Design-Prinzipien und -Patterns (z. B. SOLID)
Praxis im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Integrationsparadigmen und Schnittstellentechnologien (z. B. REST, JSON sowie auch SOAP/WSDL)
Erfahrung mit Authentifizierungs- und Sicherheitsmechanismen (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT)
